correctness.rationale: Conditional on m cyclic vertices, a uniform labeled root forest is encoded by t-1 independent draws on [n] plus a final root (t=n-m); Z equals number of absent designated noncyclic labels. Inclusion-exclusion/r-Stirling counting gives p_{n,m}(z)=t! S_m(n-1,n-z)/(z! n^(t-1)) for 1<=m<n; m=n is atom Z=0. The r-Stirling row generating polynomial (x+r)B+xB' preserves real negative simple roots, establishing row logconcavity and monotone adjacent coefficient ratios. The deletion formula S_m(N,q)=S_{m-1}(N,q)-(m-1)S_{m-1}(N-1,q), together with qS_{m-1}(N-1,q)+S_{m-1}(N-1,q-1), yields cross-m ratio strictly increasing in q=n-z. Adjacent reverse LR/TP2 comparisons, supports and transitivity give full ordering and monotone covariance. Own independent literal enumeration of every map through n=5 checked cyclic/zero indegree joint laws and cross minors. These are bounded tests, not the all-n proof.
